definitions.explanation: A natural fiber from the cotton plant, used for making fabric and textiles.

examples.japanese: この{服|ふく}は{木綿|もめん}でできています。
examples.english: This clothing is made of cotton.

examples.japanese: {木綿|もめん}の{生地|きじ}は{涼|すず}しい。
{木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ}を{買|か}いました。
examples.notes: 木綿豆腐 is firm tofu

notes:
{木綿|もめん} refers to cotton as a material.

COMMON USES:
- {木綿|もめん}の{服|ふく}: cotton clothing
- {木綿|もめん}{糸|いと}: cotton thread
- {木綿|もめん}{豆腐|どうふ}: firm tofu (vs. 絹ごし豆腐)

RELATED TERMS:
- {綿|わた}: cotton (raw/wadding)
- {絹|きぬ}: silk
- {麻|あさ}: hemp, linen
- コットン: cotton (loanword)

Note: Also read as もくめん in some compounds.
